pages.title: SFR-1 "Solstice"
pages.text: ORSA's fusion reactor: 400 kW of heat from a deuterium and tritium plasma.

pages.title: Safe, Not Easy
pages.text: Fusion never melts down. When anything goes wrong the plasma simply ends, a $(bold)disruption$(), which wears the First Wall and needs a full restart.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: $(li)A 9x9x5 torus around a Confinement Core$(li)A vacuum channel inside it$(li)High-Temperature Radiators shed the heat$(li)A 40 kW house load comes out of its own output
